text:
Question: How do I escalate a complaint that hasn't been resolved?

Answer: If your ticket remains unresolved beyond the stated SLA, use Help > Escalate Complaint in the app to route it to a senior care team, or contact the Nodal Officer for your circle as published on the NovaTel website, per TRAI's mandated grievance-redressal hierarchy.

Topic: Complaints & Grievances
title: How do I escalate a complaint that hasn't been resolved?
